description: This file defines the UserDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of User entities within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles rendering user details, permissions-based editing, and user update logic.

classes.name: UserDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for rendering and editing User entities within OrchardCore, including permission checks and localization.

methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for user display and editing.

methods.description: Handles rendering the user display in different contexts.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to the user, including validation and permission checks.
